name: design-flow
description: Agentic UI/design flow, brand-parameterised via brand packs (colours + logo; the system itself is inherited, not forked). Applies the design-system system so UI comes out consistent, modern, and responsive without a designer or Figma. /design-flow:setup scaffolds the token architecture (brand primitives -> semantic roles -> Utopia fluid scale) + layout-primitive recipes + base components for a brand through the project's UI adapter; /design-flow:component authors a component by composing layout primitives + role tokens with a fixed variant/size/state vocabulary, a11y, and prescribed responsive behavior; /design-flow:audit flags UI drift (raw colors, brittle selectors, breakpoint misuse, missing a11y/responsive). Agents: rails-ui-composer, design-auditor, brand-guardian, design-critic, rails-ui-porter. Pairs with the design-system skill (the doctrine).
